_doc: Fork only: when a failed Fork tests run gets its one automatic re-run. Read by .github/scripts/fork-ci-rerun.py
(.github/workflows/fork-ci-rerun.yml every 10 minutes); the script has no fact about this repository, these are
all of them. Runbook: .github/fork-ci-rerun.md.
trust: the fleet config beside this one; its repository, trusted workflows, actors and branches, and its rule
(fork-fleet.py run_refused), decide which runs are trusted. workflow must be one of its trusted workflows.
list_hours: how far back runs are listed (by creation; every page is read); catch_up_minutes: of those, the
runs that ended (updated) this recently. window_hours: the re-run count read from the tracking issue.
hosted_runner_groups: GitHub-hosted runners' group; an OOM kill there is the job's own (no box of ours).
probe_end_step: the step fork-ci-pressure.py writes the note in (fork-tests.yml); only a job that completed it
has a note of its own, and a job that never reached it lost its runner or was stopped.
limit_slack_seconds: a time-limit message counts only when the job (or the step) ran its minutes less this.
signs: GitHub's own runner messages, each pattern a whole message (re.fullmatch), only on an annotation in the
runner's form (failure, no title, .github), and only together with the job's step record (the script's rules).
lost: the runner went away. limit: the job or a step ran past its time limit; only with `stalled`, and only
when its minutes are that job's or step's own timeout-minutes in `workflow` at the run's commit.
cancelled_by: a person cancelled it; the run stays red.
stalled: the job's memory pressure note shows the machine or a box stalled: some-or-all-tasks-waiting (full) share
of the job's time, or the 5-minute full average at its end.
memory_full: on a runner that is not GitHub-hosted, a box with a memory limit stalled (full) at least
box_full_share_percent of the job, AND in that box OOM kills, memory.max hits or memory.high throttling.
skip_when: with this environment variable (the workflow sets it from a repository variable) at one of these
values, a run that qualifies is only reported, once, not re-run (fleet mode: a re-run of failed jobs would wait
for fleet runners that refuse it, .github/fork-fleet.md).
notice: the one tracking issue every re-run (and report) is a comment on; opened by `author` when none is open.
labels: given when it is opened (each must exist in the repository).
probe_end_step: Note memory pressure at the end

lost: The (?:self-hosted|hosted) runner: (?P<runner>.+?) lost communication with the server\..*
The runner has received a shutdown signal\..*
limit: The job running on runner (?P<runner>.+) has exceeded the maximum execution time of (?P<minutes>[0-9]+) minutes\.
The action '(?P<step>[^']+)' has timed out after (?P<minutes>[0-9]+) minutes\.
